mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is active whenever the rate trend is downward, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for at least 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0% YoY, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and increase in nonfarm payrolls indicates a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal requires both conditions to be met.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts above 800,000 units per month signals strong consumer confidence and residential investment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days during the expansion phase of the business cycle.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 800.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising retail sales figure (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer spending that supports corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is active whenever RSAFS increases month-over-month.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS increases month-over-month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 6.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate profits, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 6.5% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a drop in industrial production indicates a monetary policy response to a weakening economy, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days due to recession concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and INDPRO falls, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95.0 (index) during a manufacturing slowdown regime signals reduced corporate output and potential earnings contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 95.0, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
